title: Domain + Ports: Error categories and MetricsRecorder
description:
## Location
- internal/core/domain/errors.go (new)
- internal/core/ports/metrics.go

## TRA
Adapter.Observability.SAMLAuthErrors

## Work
- Define SAMLErrorCategory enum: signature_verification, decryption_failed, time_constraint, idp_status, unknown
- Add to MetricsRecorder interface:
  - RecordAuthFailure(category SAMLErrorCategory, idpEntityID string)
  - RecordAuthSuccess(idpEntityID string)
  - RecordAuthDuration(idpEntityID string, outcome string, duration time.Duration)
- Update NoopMetricsRecorder with stub implementations

## Done When
- [ ] Unit tests pass for category classification
- [ ] Interfaces compile
- [ ] NoopMetricsRecorder implements new methods
close_reason: Implemented SAMLErrorCategory enum and MetricsRecorder enhancements. Also fixed pre-existing import cycle (domain was importing ports for AttributeMapping - moved to domain).

title: epic
description:
As an operations engineer, I want detailed, structured error information when SAML authentication fails, so that I can quickly diagnose and resolve authentication issues without code access.

## TRA Namespace
Adapter.Observability.SAMLAuthErrors

## Scenarios
- IdP returns error status in SAML response
- Assertion signature verification fails
- Assertion decryption fails due to key mismatch
- Assertion time constraints violated
- Authentication failure increments error metric with category
- Authentication success increments success metric
- Authentication latency is recorded

title: Metrics implementation: Prometheus + wiring
description:
## Location
- internal/adapters/driven/metrics/prometheus.go
- internal/adapters/driving/caddy/saml.go

## TRA
Adapter.Observability.SAMLAuthErrors

## Work
- Implement new methods in PrometheusMetricsRecorder:
  - saml_auth_failures_total counter with labels: reason, idp
  - saml_auth_success_total counter with label: idp
  - saml_auth_duration_seconds histogram with labels: idp, outcome
- Wire metrics recording into HandleACS success/failure paths
- Add timing measurement around SAML response processing

## Done When
- [ ] Metrics tests pass
- [ ] Auth success increments saml_auth_success_total
- [ ] Auth failure increments saml_auth_failures_total with reason label
- [ ] Duration histogram records latency
close_reason: Implemented Prometheus auth metrics (failures, success, duration) and wired into ACS handlers

title: Structured error logging: Parse and categorize SAML errors
description:
## Location
- internal/adapters/driving/caddy/saml.go
- internal/adapters/driving/caddy/errors.go (new)

## TRA
Adapter.Observability.SAMLAuthErrors

## Work
- Create error parser for crewjam/saml library errors:
  - Detect signature verification failures
  - Detect decryption failures
  - Detect time constraint violations (NotBefore/NotOnOrAfter)
  - Extract IdP status code and message from SAML response
- Enhance HandleACS error path with structured logging:
  - error_category field
  - idp_entity_id field
  - Relevant context (cert fingerprints, timestamps, clock skew)
- Use zap structured logging (existing pattern in codebase)

## Done When
- [ ] Logging tests pass using zaptest/observer
- [ ] Each error category logs appropriate structured fields
- [ ] IdP status code/message extracted and logged
